name: 035.3 — the window-less panels (IBox)
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 035.3: the stylesheet reaches the client's window-LESS 9-slice panels. `panel` joins the site keys as the sibling of window.frame, and a sheet-fed IBox drops in where the panels build theirs — Frame (the portrait, the party avatars, and the list/info boxes in the character, skill, quest, wound, fight and buddy windows), ProxyFrame, Partyview.MemberView, MapWnd.ViewFrame, FlowerMenu.Petal, SListMenu, ISBox and DynresWindow.Image. Asserts: the vocabulary ("panel" is valid grammar, classifies no widget like every other site role, is listed in a misspelt-role error, and an unknown property on it is still refused); a live SURVEY of how many routed panels the HUD actually draws, class by class and flagged with which properties that kind honours — `bg` replaces a surface a panel already paints, so it reaches only the ones that paint theirs BEFORE their content (Petal, SListMenu, ISBox, Image), while a Frame is a border placed AROUND a region and drawn after it and therefore takes `border` alone, inert rather than burying the rows it frames — which is what the coverage table is written from rather than guessed; that widget:style() reports bg and border on a panel and that the panel beside it stays nil; that dropping the skin returns it to one nil; that a panel rule — pad included — moves and resizes NOTHING, because a panel decided its size and placed its children when it was built and nothing re-lays it out (inert, never an error); that a panel rule dresses no window's chrome, so the two keys stay distinct; and that dropping the sheet leaves every panel exactly as it found it. Two [manual] lines for the half a site rule leaves no value to read — whether the portrait frame and a flower menu's petals look restyled and still click through; ':t035-3 look' parks the panel theme on. Drops its sheet before it finishes, so a login that runs it leaves the client stock.
